fig01_evidence_map.figure_intent: 读者一眼看出：哪些文献能回答目标相合成的哪些问题，以及数值可迁移到多远。

ambiguous_directive_normalization.concrete_meaning: 五类来源按与目标相的距离排序，作为同一比较框架的输入
ambiguous_directive_normalization.visual_safe_instruction: 五个紧凑等级标记（同一列/同一环带序列），只画一次比较框架
ambiguous_directive_normalization.forbidden_interpretation: 为每类来源各画一条完整流程或一套表格

role_visual_realization_contract.comparison: one central ledger with 6 experiment-item rows
role_visual_realization_contract.uses: one right column with 4 answerable-question cards
role_visual_realization_contract.warning: one boundary label on the source→ledger connector

forbidden_misimplementation_locks: 非相关资料 must not connect to the ledger; it connects only to 排除 note
no causal arrows from ledger rows to uses beyond the single bundled edge
fig01_evidence_map.downstream_s1_s4_carry_forward: source ladder → single ledger → uses; one warning tag on the ladder→ledger bundle; 非相关资料 excluded path drawn dashed.

fig02_route_matrix.figure_intent: 读者一眼看出：五条合成路线在统一实验记录下并列比较，四类互补表征各回答什么。

ambiguous_directive_normalization.directive: 路线—变量—验证统一比较
ambiguous_directive_normalization.concrete_meaning: 路线是输入，统一记录是唯一比较层，表征是输出解释层
ambiguous_directive_normalization.visual_safe_instruction: 五条短工艺条（≤3 步）汇入一个记录账本；账本到四个表征卡各一条带标签边
ambiguous_directive_normalization.forbidden_interpretation: 每条路线各接一套表征；把变量画成与路线并列的方块

actor_or_condition_variation_matrix.representation: five short strips, distinct steps per strip (source-grounded), merging once

role_visual_realization_contract.routes: 5 compact strips with 3 step tokens each
role_visual_realization_contract.checks: 4 characterization cards with a simple icon motif each
role_visual_realization_contract.boundary: one boundary label under the ledger: 抽取框架 ≠ 实验处方

forbidden_misimplementation_locks: Czochralski marked 工艺参照 (dashed strip outline)
fig02_route_matrix.downstream_s1_s4_carry_forward: edge labels carry the recorded item names (配比·温度 / 熔体·容器 / 混合·煅烧 / 研磨·污染 / 籽晶·退火) and the check meanings (结构 / 相组成 / 成分 / 高温).

fig03_roadmap.figure_intent: 读者一眼看出：从文献依据到可检验实验的闭环，以及并行的固相/长晶两支各回答什么。

ambiguous_directive_normalization.concrete_meaning: 一条主线 + 一次分叉（固相/长晶）+ 一条反馈环 + 三个待答问题
ambiguous_directive_normalization.visual_safe_instruction: 主线居中，分叉在前驱体之后，合流于结果反馈；反馈环回到结构假设；三个问题作为紧凑标签挂在相应阶段
ambiguous_directive_normalization.forbidden_interpretation: 为 Zn/Mg/Co 三个目标各画一条流程；多条反馈环

actor_or_condition_variation_matrix.representation: one tag on the precursor module (ZnO / MgO / Co3O4), never three lanes

role_visual_realization_contract.mainline: 文献依据 → 结构假设 → 前驱体 → {固相成相 | 高温溶液长晶} → 结果反馈
role_visual_realization_contract.feedback: one return edge 结果反馈 → 结构假设, labelled 更新组成与工艺
role_visual_realization_contract.questions: three compact question tags attached to 结构假设 / 分叉 / 结果反馈

forbidden_misimplementation_locks: precursor module must carry 模型排序≠验证 tag
fig03_roadmap.downstream_s1_s4_carry_forward: branch outputs are distinct: 批量相区与相纯度 (solid) vs 单晶结构与液相选择性 (growth).

palette_human_taste_contract.secondary_accent: #B8862B (warm ochre: caveats, model-derived or hypothesis items)
anti_ai_rules: no decorative icons unrelated to the paper
palette_human_taste_contract.grayscale: distinctions also carried by line style (solid/dashed) and chip shape
